name: Styx
description: The MCP-native AI API gateway for developers building with LLMs. Every app using AI needs API keys, cost control, and provider flexibility — Styx gives you all three through one endpoint. Route requests to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or Mistral with automatic failover, track spending in real-time, and manage team access with scoped API keys. Self-hosted, open source, and manageable directly from Claude Code with /styx:setup, /styx:status, and @styx-ops.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, **1 agent**, **2 commands** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (1): `styx-gateway` (Use when managing AI API keys, routing LLM requests across providers, checking gateway health, viewing usage analytics, or…)
- **Agents** (1): `styx-ops` (Infrastructure agent for diagnosing Styx gateway issues, optimizing routing, and managing API keys)
- **Commands** (2): `setup` (Set up and start the Styx AI API gateway locally), `status` (Check Styx gateway health, usage stats, and provider status)
- **MCP servers** (1): `styx-gateway`

Installs with `claude plugin install styx@claude-community` from `timmx7/styx` (`claude-code-plugin`).
